# fakecloud_tictactoe_board (Data Source)

Look up a board by id — for the opponent who joined a duel they didn't create, or for printing the board with an output block.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a board you don't manage — e.g. your duel opponent's.
data "fakecloud_tictactoe_board" "opponent" {
  id = 1
}

output "board" {
  value = data.fakecloud_tictactoe_board.opponent.cells
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Board id, as shown on the dashboard.

### Read-Only

- `cells` (List of String) Current board, 9 cells row by row.
- `mode` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `nameplate_text` (String) Text of the board's nameplate, if one exists.
- `next_player` (String)
- `winner` (String)
